## Definition

A **moving average (MA)** process smooths white noise:

$$v_t = \frac{1}{3}(w_{t-1} + w_t + w_{t+1})$$


More generally,


$$X_t = \sum_{j=-q}^{q} \theta_j w_{t-j}$$


## Intuition

- Local averaging  
- Introduces short-range dependence  
- Remains stationary  

## Autocovariance

Only overlapping noise terms contribute:


$$\gamma(h) = 0 \quad \text{for } |h| > q$$


## Python example

```python
import numpy as np
from scipy.signal import convolve

w = np.random.normal(0,1,500)
v = convolve(w, np.ones(3)/3, mode='same')
```
